title: Drill Bit Holder with Locking Latch – Quick-Release
descriptionHtml:
Quick drill bit changes

Screwing bits in and out by hand takes time and is fiddly. Small parts are easily lost in the middle of the job.

A locking latch that makes the job fast

With the locking latch you change bits quickly and easily with one hand. It's small, handy and fits in the toolbox or your pocket.

Features

  • Quick drill bit changes
  • Locking latch for easy handling
  • Small and handy to store
  • Good for the garage, motorhome and workshop
  • Durable material

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
